subject: general
question: The Longest Moustache competition is held at which of the following festivals/fairs?
solution:
The correct answer is **" Pushkar fair ".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pushkar is one of the world's** largest camel fair**.
 
• It has become an important **tourist attraction**.
 
• Competitions such as **matka phod, bridal competition, and longest moustache** attract thousands of tourists.
 
• It is a** 9 day** long fair that takes place in **Rajasthan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kila Raipur sports festival** is also known as the rural Olympics that takes place annually at **Kila Raipur near Ludhiana Punjab.**
 
• **Hornbill festival **is an annual festival celebrated in **Nagaland**.
 
• **Thrissur Pooram festival **is an annual Hindu temple festival held in **Thrissur, Kerala.**
